senses.exampleCN: 这项条约在该地区划出一条新的政治分歧线。
senses.why: Two sides that no longer align are like two blocks offset along a seam, so the metaphor is structural.
senses.whyCN: 两侧不再对齐，就像沿缝错开的两块岩体，所以这个比喻是结构性的。

senses.title: A social fracture
senses.definition: a deep division in a society that may suddenly widen
senses.definitionCN: 社会中可能突然扩大的深层分裂
senses.example: Housing costs exposed a fault line between generations.
senses.exampleCN: 住房成本暴露出代际之间的一条裂痕。
senses.why: The image predicts sudden rupture: a line that looks quiet can slip when stress builds.
senses.whyCN: 这个形象预示突然破裂：看似平静的线在应力积累时会错动。

senses.title: A dividing line within an organisation
senses.definition: a split between factions inside a group or alliance
senses.definitionCN: 群体或联盟内部派系之间的分裂
senses.example: The budget vote revealed a fault line in the coalition.
senses.exampleCN: 预算投票暴露出执政联盟内部的一条分界线。
senses.why: An alliance holds together like a rock mass, and a fault line is where it may separate.
senses.whyCN: 联盟像岩体一样连在一起，而断层线就是它可能分开的地方。

intro.en: Fault line is an English compound of the geological noun fault and the Latin-derived noun line, used both literally and as a metaphor. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: fault line 是英语复合词，由地质名词 fault 与拉丁来源的名词 line 构成，既有字面用法，也有比喻用法。年代均为约数。

items.en: Fault goes back to Latin fallere 'to fail, deceive' through Old French faute, and acquired its rock-break sense in mining.
items.cn: fault 经古法语 faute 上溯到拉丁语 fallere「失败、欺骗」，并在采矿用语中获得岩石破裂义。

items.en: Line comes from Latin linea 'string, cord, line', from linum 'flax', and already meant a drawn stroke in classical use.
items.cn: line 来自拉丁语 linea「绳、线」，再上溯到 linum「亚麻」，在古典用法中已指画出的线条。

items.en: The noun fault was applied to rock breaks, and line was the natural word for the trace where that break reaches the surface.
items.cn: 名词 fault 被用于岩石破裂，而 line 自然成为描述该破裂出露地表之迹线的词。

items.en: Survey geologists drew fault lines on maps, fixing the compound as a technical term.
items.cn: 地质调查人员在地图上画出断层线，使这个复合词固定为技术术语。

items.en: Journalists extended fault line to politics and society, where it names a division that can suddenly rupture.
items.cn: 记者把 fault line 扩展到政治与社会领域，用来指可能突然破裂的分裂线。

note.en: Group one holds compounds and single words that look or sound like fault line; group two holds nouns for rifts and divisions.
note.cn: 第一组是形音接近 fault line 的复合词与单词；第二组是表示裂痕与分裂的名词。

entries.definition: the break itself; fault line is only its surface trace or a metaphor built on it.
entries.definitionCN: 破裂本身；fault line 只是它在地表的迹线或由此构成的比喻。

entries.definition: defective; it is an adjective and has no line component.
entries.definitionCN: 有缺陷的；它是形容词，不含 line 成分。

entries.definition: the outer edge of a shape or a summary; it contains line but not fault.
entries.definitionCN: 形状的外缘或概要；它含 line 但不含 fault。

entries.definition: a reference line for measurement; the first element is base, not fault.
entries.definitionCN: 测量用的基准线；前半部分是 base，不是 fault。

entries.definition: a crack or a place where the crust is pulling apart; it is a widening gap, not a trace line.
entries.definitionCN: 裂缝，或地壳被拉开的地方；它是一条变宽的缝隙，不是迹线。

entries.definition: a long narrow crack in rock or ground; it describes the opening rather than the fault structure.
entries.definitionCN: 岩石或地面上细长的裂缝；它描述裂口本身，而非断层结构。

entries.definition: any break in a material; a fault line is a geological structure, while a fracture can be tiny.
entries.definitionCN: 材料中的任何断裂；断层线是地质构造，而断裂可以很小。

entries.definition: a separation between groups or regions; it lacks the image of sudden rupture.
entries.definitionCN: 群体或区域之间的分隔；它缺少「突然破裂」的形象。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the compound is exactly its two parts, and the metaphor keeps the same geometry.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：这个复合词就是两个组成部分，而比喻也保持同样的几何关系。

normal.en: fault plus line: a fault is a surface, and its line is where that surface cuts the ground.
normal.cn: fault 加 line：断层是一个面，而这条线就是这个面切过地面的地方。

normal.en: A fault line on a map is drawn with a solid line where known and a dashed line where uncertain.
normal.cn: 地图上的断层线在确定处画实线，在不确定处画虚线。

normal.en: A political fault line works like a rock fault: two sides no longer line up, and stress can make them slip.
normal.cn: 政治上的 fault line 与岩石断层同理：两侧不再对齐，应力会让它们错动。

normal.en: A rift is an open gap; a fault line is the trace of the break that made it.
normal.cn: rift 是张开的缝隙；fault line 是造成这条缝的破裂迹线。

normal.en: The San Andreas Fault gives its name to a very well known fault line.
normal.cn: 圣安德烈斯断层给一条非常著名的断层线提供了名字。

abstract.en: Abstractly, a fault line is a place where a whole is already divided but still touching.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，fault line 是一个整体已经分开却仍然相接的地方。

abstract.en: The metaphor is useful because it predicts sudden change: quiet lines can rupture when stress accumulates.
abstract.cn: 这个比喻有用，因为它预示突然变化：平静的线在应力积累时会破裂。

abstract.en: Symbol: a thin broken line across a surface, with two blocks offset slightly on either side.
abstract.cn: 符号：地表一条细长的断续线，两侧岩块略微错开。

examples.en: The village lies directly on the fault line.
examples.cn: 这个村庄正好位于断层线上。

examples.en: Geologists traced the fault line for fifty kilometres.
examples.cn: 地质学家追踪这条断层线达五十公里。

examples.en: The election exposed a fault line inside the party.
examples.cn: 这次选举暴露出党内的一条分歧线。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「缝特 + 线」—— 岩层断开的缝在地面上连成一条线 → fault line 断层线

root: 由地质术语 fault（断层）与拉丁来源的 line（线）复合而成，字面义为「断层的线」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of fault line. The thread is a visible trace: first a rock break at the surface, then any line along which a whole may split.
sensesIntro.cn: fault line 的八个义项。主线是一条可见的迹线：先是地表出露的岩石破裂，再是任何可能使整体分裂的界线。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a visible line where two blocks meet and no longer align.
core.cn: 核心意象：两块岩体相接却不再对齐的一条可见线。

branches.en: TRACE: the visible line and its drawn symbol on a map.
branches.cn: 迹线：可见的线，以及地图上的绘制符号。

branches.en: SEISMIC LINE: the line marks where earthquakes are expected.
branches.cn: 地震线：标出预期发生地震的位置。

branches.en: MATERIAL PATH: engineering borrows the image for a prepared line of failure.
branches.cn: 材料路径：工程借用这个形象指预设的破坏路径。

branches.en: SOCIAL RUPTURE: politics, society and organisations split along such a line.
branches.cn: 社会破裂：政治、社会与组织沿这样的线分裂。

branches.en: THE BROKEN BELT: the line stands for the shattered zone it runs through.
branches.cn: 破碎带：这条线代表它所穿过的破碎地带。

intro.en: Fault line is a compound of two complete words, so its analysis is the analysis of fault plus line.
intro.cn: fault line 是两个完整词构成的复合词，因此它的构词分析就是 fault 加 line 的分析。

latinIntro.en: Fault is from Latin fallere via Old French; line is from Latin linea 'string, line'. Both halves are Latin-derived, which is why latinEntries lists both.
latinIntro.cn: fault 经古法语来自拉丁语 fallere；line 来自拉丁语 linea「绳、线」。两半都源自拉丁语，因此 latinEntries 两侧都列。

items.example: The fault cuts through layered rock.
items.exampleCN: 这条断层切穿层状岩石。

items.meaning: a drawn stroke or a row of points
items.example: The line runs north to south.
items.exampleCN: 这条线由北向南延伸。

items.meaning: the surface trace of a fault
items.example: The fault line passes under the town.
items.exampleCN: 断层线从镇下通过。

items.structure: fault line used as an adjective
items.meaning: relating to or along a fault line
items.meaningCN: 与断层线有关的，或沿断层线的
items.example: Fault-line valleys follow the break.
items.exampleCN: 断层线谷地沿破裂延伸。

items.meaning: the mapped path of the surface break
items.meaningCN: 地表破裂在地图上的路径
items.example: The fault-line trace is offset by a later quake.
items.exampleCN: 断层迹线被后来的地震错开。

items.meaning: the broken belt around the line
items.example: The fault zone is wider than the line itself.
items.exampleCN: 断层带比这条线本身更宽。

items.meaning: a large linear feature on the Earth's surface
items.example: Satellite images show a long lineament.
items.exampleCN: 卫星图像显示出一条长线状构造。

items.example: The boundary line follows the ridge.
items.exampleCN: 边界线沿着山脊。
